nodes.title: Mount rocking stiffness needed for the separation rule, recommended design
nodes.equation: sweep k_rock over 500-30 000 N m/rad (k_twist fixed) on both quarters at nominal and low E/G; k_req = smallest k with sep_op >= sep_min at every larger k (log interpolation)

nodes.title: Mesh convergence, recommended design (both sides)
nodes.equation: first dominant station mode f1 (>= 50 % kinetic energy in the motor body) and sep_op at fin meshes 12x10, 24x20 (used), 36x30; change = max over sides of |f1(24x20)/f1(36x30) - 1| and |sep(24x20)/sep(36x30) - 1| (f2 reported only: near 360-600 Hz it swaps between coupled modes)

nodes.title: Gyroscopic whirl separation, recommended design (both sides)
nodes.equation: M q'' + Omega G q' + K q = 0 on 16 modes, G = -[Ip_spin e_shaft]x at the station, e_shaft = (-cos c, s sin c t_y, s sin c t_z) with the tangential cant c and both senses s = +/-1; sep over 1P/2P at hover and cruise and 1P at the cap, station whirl modes only; f_whirl_* = whirl frequencies of the first station mode at hover and cruise rpm (lowest over sides and senses)

nodes.title: Fin, tube, brace, collar, edge-strip bond and anchor strength, recommended design (both sides, LE fillet intact and cracked)
nodes.equation: FE static, limit cases L1 (C1 peak foot), L4 (side = max(mu F_corner, C5 side load), both senses), L5 (both senses), foot loads at the C1 ground point (x_te + foot_h, z_pad) through a rigid D5 shoe on the square tip; G2 (both senses, n_h m g at the tube end), H2c (T_lim along the 7 deg canted shaft at the prop centre + Q about the shaft, 4 sign combinations), H2s = H2c + B4 misbuilt swirl x (T_lim/T_hover)^exp as a line load at the B4 centre of pressure, both senses; G3 (lower quarter) set-down force at the motor body toward the wing; envelope over upper/lower quarter and LE fillet intact / cracked between the boss and the collar; section torque at the wing plane from the FE reactions (fin root + boss nodes, tube root spring, brace anchor) vs C1's wing-plane torque, equilibrium residual vs the applied torque; ultimate = sf x limit (joints x fit x prt); face = Q_f (eps0 + z kappa); collar torque = jump of the tube torque across the collar band; strip-to-paper shear flow per face q = |dN|/2/ds + |V|/d (foot-shoe nodes excluded), tau = q/w vs kd tau_board; strip end force per face = |N0|/2 + |M0|/d; pin force = q jf pitch; brace Pcr = pi^2 E w t^3 / (12 L^2); brace-end bond tau = F / (2 (w + t) engage); ear root s = 6 F (ear/2) / (w_ear h^2) + F / (w_ear h); collar bond tau = T / (2 pi r^2 h) + F / (pi d h), h_req at MS 0; anchor tau = F / (len_y pi d_spar / 4) vs peel x bond allowable

outputs.governing: edge: L4- up_cr; face: L4- up; mroot: L4- up_cr; q_face: L4- up; strip_end: L4- up_cr; t_collar: L4+ up_cr; t_root: L4+ up; tube: L4- up_cr

nodes.title: Brace strip 10 x 2 against 10 x 3 (CR-C4-16), recommended design
nodes.equation: for t in (10 x 3, 10 x 2): sep_op (both quarters, nominal E/G); G2 brace force from the FE (limit, both quarters) x sf x fit vs Pcr = pi^2 E w t^3 / (12 L^2); mass of four braces = 4 rho w t L_mean; CR-B1-18 edge rounding of the 10 x 2 (both 2 mm edges full round, r = t/2): A and I_weak lose 2 (2 r^2 - pi r^2 / 2) and 2 (r (2r)^3 / 12 - pi r^4 / 8), Pcr scales with I; tape fairing = 4 x areal x perimeter (2 w + pi t) x 1.5 overlap x L_mean

nodes.title: Motor mount on the tube end with the 7 deg tangential cant
nodes.equation: t = (-z_st, y_fin)/|.| (motor-circle tangent); F = T (-cos c, sin c t_y, sin c t_z) at r = (x_prop - x_tube, 0, z_st - L_tube/2) from the tube end; side = T sin c; axial = T sin c |t_z|; twist about the tube = |r_x| T sin c |t_y| + Q sin c |t_z|; rocking = |r x F| in x-y (worst sign) + Q cos c; design = limit x sf x fit x prt; slip-clamp use = sqrt((F_ax,d / (T_slip / r))^2 + ((M_tw,d + M_C1,ult fit prt) / T_slip)^2) (C1's mount moment taken wholly about the tube: conservative); G3 set-down (CR-C1-24): axial push F_g3 on the lip cap, bearing on the tube-wall annulus s = F_g3 jf / (pi/4 (od^2 - id^2)); rocking F_g3 |x_motor - x_tube|, x_motor = x_face - l_motor/2; rocking envelope = max(H2c, G3)

nodes.title: Through-core block on D3's geometry (bosses not credited for strength)
nodes.equation: as CALC-C4-BLOCK with h = core depth at the tube (z_upper - z_lower at x_t): tube bore s = 6M/(d h^2) + F/(d h); shear-out tau = (1.5 M / h)/(e h), e = (W - d)/2; spar bore s = 6M/(d W^2) + F/(d W); web s = 6M/(W h^2), tau = M/(0.21 W h^2); bond torsion tau = 2 My sf fit prt/(pi d^2 W)

nodes.title: Ultimate proof of one TEST-ARTICLE fin quarter (not a flight fin; CR-H1-17)
nodes.procedure: Test article built with flight processes but never flown: one LOWER quarter (it carries G3 and the longer free tube) = one 0.21 m half-fin cut from the flight board batch (two 4.8 mm layers laminated), CF 22 x 20 tube offcut 0.20 m, PETG through-core block bonded on a 0.15 m spar offcut in a 0.15 m core offcut, plug, station collar (as drawn, 12 mm), CF 10 x 2 brace 0.16 m with anchor saddle on the same spar offcut, CF 10 x 1 edge strips x 2 with 2 mm CF pins at 15 mm, ASA mount with a dummy motor (steel slug at the motor CG, M3 x 8 into the plate), D5 shoe and foot, LE fillet LEFT UNBONDED (fail-safe case), 30 min epoxy as in BUILD. Steps, each held 30 s, loads at 1.5 x limit through a hand-held spring scale or hung weights: (1) L4 at the C1 ground point 44 N along + 31 N across, both senses; (2) G2 77 N lateral at the tube end, both senses; (3) G3 35 N on the dummy can toward the wing. Pass: no crack, face wrinkle, strip lift, pin push-out or bond-line movement (witness lines on collar, strip ends, brace ends, anchor); foot deflection at 1.0 x L4 <= 1.2 x CL-C4-D3-FOOT-DEFL. Then load step (1) to failure and record the load and the failed part. Flight fins get a 1.0 x limit L4 hand check only.

nodes.title: Mount rocking stiffness on the bench
nodes.procedure: Mount with motor clamped on a 60 mm tube stub held in a vice; 0.5 kg over a pulley at the prop nut, sideways (y) and fore-aft (z); dial gauges at the motor can top and at the collar; theta = (d_can - d_collar) / spacing; k = F a / theta. Pass: k >= the CL-C4-D3-MOUNT-K-REQ value in both directions.

nodes.title: Tap test, as-built upper and lower quarter
nodes.procedure: Finished wing on foam blocks, props on; tap each motor bell in y and in z; FC raw IMU at 1 kHz (or a phone accelerometer taped to the can); FFT peaks vs 1P/2P at hover, cruise and the cap.
